run_make_input_csv: run make_input_csv.py to convert plain text lines into a CSV with command and word columns
create_csv_from_stdin: pipe text lines into make_input_csv.py to produce a CSV with padded word columns
convert_commands_to_csv: convert a list of command sentences into a CSV format with up to 30 word columns
generate_ttad_annotate_input: generate input CSV files for the TTAD annotation tool from raw command text files
pad_words_to_max: pad each command's words to MAX_WORDS columns using make_input_csv.py for consistent CSV output
